purpose: Prevent ambiguous phase references by preserving independently numbered governance tracks without renumbering or changing any historical claim.

decision.rule: A bare phase number is not a globally unique project identifier.

tracks.scope: Public activation readiness and gated ecosystem lanes
tracks.status_summary: Phases 8-17 record public-ready and authorization-gated lanes; Phase 18 is open for review only.

tracks.scope: Reproducible deployment and artifact verification surfaces
tracks.status_summary: Phases 8-12 are separately sealed, read-only evidence work and do not change public activation state.

tracks.scope: Public mint execution-path design and final decision gates
tracks.status_summary: Phase 28 records NO_GO_PUBLIC_MINT_EXECUTION_NOT_READY; no signing or broadcast is authorized.

reconciliation_rules: Do not rewrite or delete historical receipts to make phase numbers appear globally unique.
Every future phase receipt must include a namespace and canonical identifier.
A phase claim must cite its source receipt, tag, or commit.
Phase 26 and later execution records remain distinct from public-ready and evidence records.
No reconciliation record authorizes wallet signing, broadcasts, token transfers, minting, liquidity, staking, bridging, or custody changes.
acceptance_criteria: Each identified track has one immutable namespace.
Existing phase numbers and source records remain unchanged.
Future phase objectives use a namespace-qualified canonical identifier.
The public-ready Phase 18 review-only gate and execution Phase 28 NO-GO decision remain visible.
The reconciliation is validated as JSON and by existing evidence/build checks.
